title: Useless Items
description: A simple mod aimed at making some items less useless.
body:
#  Mechanics and Recipes:


Wandering Trader
-  Break discs on cobblestone to obtain broken discs
-  Broken discs can be traded with a Wandering Trader for a Trident.

 Rotten Flesh
- Restores maximum health to dogs and cats
- Can be converted into bones
- Using it at a Brewing Stand makes a zombification potion

 Zombification Potion
- When drunk, it provides effects of strength, health boost, and hunger for 5 minutes 
- By left-clicking on a villager with this potion, you transform them into a zombie

 Feather
- They can be used to repair elytra

 Wet Sponge
- Right-clicking on a cursed item removes the curse

 Dead Bush
- If placed on a block of dirt, it becomes a sapling
- Can be crafted using sticks
  
 Oil Bottle
 
- A oil bottle made from seeds lasts three times longer than coal 
  
 Honey 
- Honey bottle complete recovery saturation
- Click on a beehive with a pot to fill it with honey
- Having a pot of honey in your inventory, by right-clicking with a glass bottle you can fill it with honey the pot's uses vary from 1 to 50 uses

 Lily of the valley
- Crafting an immunity option makes you immune to negative effects for 10 minutes

 Compass
- Right-clicking on it reveals the location of nearby mobs

 Eggfication Potion

- When thrown at a turtle, chicken, or villager, it turns into an egg

- There is a 1% chance of a chicken turning into a Golden egg 

- The golden egg spawns a hen that lays gold nuggets

 Emerald Pickaxe

- When crafted, it receives a Fortune enchantment

 Dog Treat

- Grants a damage buff to your wolf for 1 minute

 Poisoned Potato: Paralyzation potion

- Applies a weakness, slowness, and blindness effect to the target for 30 seconds

 Enchanted Bottle 

- Holding a book in your off-hand and a bottle in your main hand, you can make enchanted bottles

- Use a book in your main hand to transfer your experience levels to another player by right-clicking on it
  
- Using 9 Bottles o’ Enchanting and a Heart of the Sea, you can craft an Enchanted Heart

 Filters

- Automatically deletes unwanted items from your inventory  (It doesn't work in creative mode)
  
- Mob filter: bones, rotten flesh, arrow, feathers
  
- Miner filter: andesite, diorite, gravel, granite 

 MinerMan Potion

- Apply the haste and speed for 5 minutes
- It can be found in loot

 Enchanted Heart

- Right-click to activate

- It provides regeneration, health boost, and stamina effects that become stronger with each heart level gained

-  To increase the heart level, you need to kill the mobs required in the item description

- Hearts can regress in level if you die

- The hearts have alternative options that guarantee a 100% chance of upgrade

- Killing a skeleton horse while having any heart in your inventory will advance you to the max level

- Enchanted hearts do not burn in lava

LVL1 | Regression chance: 0% |  Upgrade chance: 5% | Alt:  Witch
LVL2 | Regression chance: 50% |  Upgrade chance: 0,5% | Alt:  Endermite
LVL3 | Regression chance: 5% |  Upgrade chance: 50% | Alt:  Ender dragon
LVL4 | Regression chance: 0,5% |  Upgrade chance: 100% | Alt:  Skeleton Horse

- A enchanted heart level 5 can become a disenchanted heart to recover it, it needs to be placed on a Smithing Table along with an enchanted bottle
